items.title: Yum Brands Inc (YUM) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Post-Pizza Hut Growth, Taco Bell ...
items.summary: Yum Brands Inc (YUM) posted 3% system sales growth and 7% unit growth ex-Pizza Hut, with Taco Bell US recovering from a food safety setback and KFC International delivering 9% system sales growth.

items.title: Yum Brands flags AI as ‘transformative to the business’
items.summary: KFC and Taco Bell’s parent company is adding the tech to kitchens, drive-thrus and management strategies in a modernization push, CFO Ranjith Roy said.

items.title: Taco Bell sales rebounding after cyclosporiasis outbreak
items.summary: Taco Bell's sales are recovering after a cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to lettuce served at some of its restaurants hurt business over the summer.

items.title: Yum! Brands (YUM) Unveils KFC Muse Flagship In Dubai
items.summary: Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) introduced KFC Muse, a new global flagship restaurant design, with an inaugural site in Dubai. The KFC Muse format debuts a fresh visual identity along with a more immersive in store environment for guests. The Dubai flagship showcases bespoke offerings, including the KWENCH beverage range and customizable KFC MIX'D meal options. A second KFC Muse location is planned for Seoul, signaling Yum! Brands' focus on experiential dining concepts and international expansion...

items.title: An entire island just lost its KFC and Taco Bell overnight
items.summary: Yum! Brands abruptly ended its relationship with the Puerto Rican operator of KFC and Taco Bell.

items.title: Taco Bell’s loyalty program helped the brand recover from Cyclospora outbreak
items.summary: Loyalty members returned to Taco Bell twice as quickly as non-loyalty customers following a foodborne illness scare this summer, parent company Yum Brands CEO Chris Turner said.
